authorship: Original design recipes included with this skill; not scraped from external sites.

recipes.name: Editorial Warmth
recipes.thesis: An inviting print-journal feel with generous margins and asymmetrical image-led sections.
recipes.layout: Two-column narratives; large pull quotes; slim metadata rail; editorial feature blocks.
recipes.typography: High-contrast display serif plus clean grotesk for controls.
recipes.surfaces: Paper-like surfaces, hairline separators, modest image shadows.
recipes.motion: Subtle image fade and restrained scroll reveal.

recipes.name: Civic Clarity
recipes.thesis: Direct, calm language and visibly navigable structure communicate reliability.
recipes.layout: Single dominant task column; clear page sections; persistent breadcrumb/help cues.
recipes.typography: Friendly humanist sans for all UI; strong numeral treatment.
recipes.surfaces: High-contrast inputs, visible separators, restrained elevation.

recipes.name: Quiet Workspace
recipes.thesis: Reduce visual noise so important work, not chrome, stays in focus.
recipes.layout: Adaptive side navigation, content work area, subtle top command bar.
recipes.typography: Neutral contemporary sans with tabular numeric data.
recipes.surfaces: Very light neutral panels, selective borders, low shadows.
recipes.motion: Motion only for state transitions; compact duration.

recipes.name: Precision Grid
recipes.thesis: Explicit grids and crisp alignment make complex data legible and trustworthy.
recipes.layout: Dense 12-column desktop layout, modular status panels, mobile priority stack.
recipes.typography: Compact sans and monospace for labels, ids and quantitative data.
recipes.surfaces: Thin borders and strong focus outlines; no floating decoration.
recipes.motion: Discrete, functional feedback; no ambient effects.

recipes.name: Playful Utility
recipes.thesis: Delight users while keeping primary actions understandable and easy to reach.
recipes.layout: Oversized primary action, simple cards, contextual illustrations, shallow navigation.
recipes.typography: Rounded humanist sans with expressive heavy display weight.
recipes.surfaces: Rounded shapes, limited bright color accents, large iconography.

recipes.name: Atelier Contrast
recipes.thesis: Use bold type, carefully chosen photography and restraint to communicate confidence.
recipes.layout: Full-bleed hero paired with whitespace, modular gallery, low-noise navigation.
recipes.typography: Sculptural display serif combined with editorial sans captions.
recipes.surfaces: Flat editorial surfaces, carefully cropped imagery, no excessive ornament.
recipes.motion: Slow but optional transitions; maintain immediate navigation.

recipes.name: Marketplace Signal
recipes.thesis: Make filtering, comparative information and confidence signals effortless.
recipes.layout: Persistent search; filter sidebar desktop/drawer mobile; readable listing grid.
recipes.typography: Neutral UI sans with firm prices and helpful typographic contrast.
recipes.surfaces: Clean item boundaries, consistent cards, accessible filter chips.
recipes.motion: Fast filter updates with visible feedback.

recipes.name: Night Studio
recipes.thesis: A dark stage emphasizes selective highlights and purposeful composition.
recipes.layout: Bold hero with asymmetric work tiles and clear project narrative.
recipes.typography: Distinct geometric headline with highly readable body sans.
recipes.surfaces: Large quiet dark zones, precise contrast boundaries, spotlight imagery.
recipes.motion: Soft reveal and hover preview only with alternatives.

recipes.name: Friendly Finance
recipes.thesis: Translate intimidating numbers into understandable next actions.
recipes.layout: Summary first, explanations beside charts, direct drill-in affordances.
recipes.typography: Modern sans with tabular numbers and readable annotations.
recipes.surfaces: Soft green-gray surfaces, disciplined badges, high data ink ratio.
recipes.motion: Trend chart updates without flashy number scrambling.

recipes.name: Nature Fieldbook
recipes.thesis: Organic textures and practical information combine warmth with clarity.
recipes.layout: Image-led journal rhythm plus well-structured utility panels.
recipes.typography: Soft serif display and readable sans body with organic curves.
recipes.surfaces: Warm paper tones, editorial blocks, subtle rule work.

recipes.name: Neo-Brutalist Cards
recipes.thesis: Unexpected hard-edged contrasts convey energy without hiding the task.
recipes.layout: Blocky layout with large headings, distinct steps, staggered highlights.
recipes.typography: Wide heavy sans with strong hierarchy and concise labels.
recipes.surfaces: Hard borders, offset shadows, limited flat colors.
recipes.motion: Snap transitions and strong focus states.

recipes.name: Museum Archive
recipes.thesis: Let content provenance and considered typography carry visual authority.
recipes.layout: Category indexes, date hierarchy, layered story pages, accessible discovery controls.
recipes.typography: Old-style serif titles with humanist sans navigation.
recipes.surfaces: Quiet rules, archival frames, measured spatial rhythm.

recipes.name: Bright Education
recipes.thesis: A welcoming learning environment makes progress and next actions explicit.
recipes.layout: Lesson path + progress summary + immediate continue action.
recipes.typography: Friendly rounded sans; generous body readability.
recipes.surfaces: Low-elevation cards and selective illustrative elements.

recipes.name: Monochrome Editor
recipes.thesis: The canvas is for content; controls retreat until relevant.
recipes.layout: Centered editor with contextual tools and discoverable structure rail.
recipes.typography: Reading-oriented serif or neutral sans; distinguish interface labels.
recipes.surfaces: Near-white surfaces and subtle divisions, visible selection highlights.
recipes.motion: No ornamental animations; fast cursor response.

recipes.name: Retro Tech
recipes.thesis: Period-inspired constraints become a memorable interface without losing modern usability.
recipes.layout: Grid overlays, status strips, oversized functional modules.
recipes.typography: Monospace accents + robust sans for long-form reading.
recipes.surfaces: Subtle screen-like texture (optional), crisp strokes, strong contrast.
recipes.motion: Limited blink effects; never animate essential content.

recipes.name: Airy Wellness
recipes.thesis: Create calm reassurance while retaining direct, comprehensible actions.
recipes.layout: Breathing space, simple onboarding, concise cards with clear CTA.
recipes.typography: Elegant but legible serif accents and simple body sans.
recipes.surfaces: Low-pressure color fields, minimal dividers, soft corners.
